**Release scope:** a new release, separate from feac6534.
- `git log --first-parent feac6534..ae64f169` contains exactly two merges: PR #288 (#205, at audited head `77e38c21`) and PR #290 (at audited head `15a826be`).
- Both PRs have an exact-head "Audit passed" and green checks. Main CI on ae64f169 is green.
- There are no ungated PRs.
- #274 and #284 are deferred.
- The only migration in the range is `20261010000400_preparation_records`. I recomputed its SHA256 from `ae64f169` and it equals e2d59e7b. It is additive only: a new append-only PreparationRecord table with 3 indexes and 3 guard triggers, plus a nullable `WorkItemDraft.records` TEXT column.

**What I verified myself**
- **Kit file hashes.** I recomputed the hash of all 22 git-tracked kit files listed in the manifest (17 scripts and records at `2ebf2b3d`, plus the receipt, kit index, build-origin and gate snapshot on the branch). Every one matches. `source.tar.gz` and `source-index.json` stay on the host and are bound through build receipt `08714c72…`, which matches.
- **Receipt contents.** The receipt status is PASSED.
  - `productionExecution` is false.
  - 21 prior-schema verifiers ran as DRY_RUN with `totalChanges` 0. #272 is correctly ALREADY_PRESENT.
  - Retained acceptance was checked read-only only: event `0c4a247e…` with fingerprint `d14c99ff…`, attempt ACCEPTED, ReviewDecision attemptId NULL, report PUBLISHED.
  - #205 went PRE_205 to COMPLETE_205 with no backfill. The repeat run was NO_OP/0 and the database bytes were preserved.
  - 21 ordered READY events, all zero-change.
  - 31/31 API checks and 6/6 probes passed, with zero database changes from probes or startup.
- **Preservation.** All 103 original tables are byte-equal on their original fields. The only exception is `_schema_migrations`, with 37 rows preserved plus exactly one `205_preparation_records` row. PreparationRecord is empty. Integrity is ok and FK violations are 0.
- **Schema comparison** (the point I raised earlier). `preserve()` asserts that:
  - every original column shape is unchanged;
  - `records` is the last column, TEXT and nullable;
  - the table SQL equals the reviewed ALTER replayed in memory on the original SQL itself, so the original constraints and defaults cannot drift unnoticed;
  - exactly 7 new schema objects exist, all on PreparationRecord.
- **Memory.** 24 CLI runs at a limit of 805306368 B, with no heap override and all exit codes 0. The peak was 555188224 B. The startup peak was 353198080 B.
- **Guard tests.** I ran `python3 -m unittest test_release_guards` on the frozen bytes myself: 13/13 OK, matching log `d0d9b44a…`.
- **Coordinator safeguards.**
  - It refuses without a fresh GitHub gate no more than 600 s old. That gate must bind this comment, the head, all three kit hashes, the migration hash, the YY evidence hash and both workload pins.
  - It enforces the disk reserve and the 500 MB unexplained-drop abort.
  - Writers are stopped before the backup is taken.
  - Only the #205 installer may apply.
  - After any installer attempt, recovery is forward-only. There is no database restore and no restart of the previous image.

**Authorization:** YY's standing go applies: "Auto after review", extended by "my go covers all", 2026-10-10 16:58:15 UTC in the "Progress recap and remaining work" thread. The evidence file above records it, with scopeHead ae64f169 and scopeDecision PREPARATION_AND_RESULTS_288_290.

**Workload pins:** `labAndHubBuildsOwnedByYY=true` and `RELEASE_DAY_DISK_ABORTS_ACCEPTED`.

**For Pip:** execute this unchanged kit only after collecting one fresh gate. Keep every abort gate in force. Merges of follow-up PRs stay held until ae64f169 is live. After you post "Deployed ae64f169… to production", I'll run the post-deploy checks and then close #205.
